about.summary: Safety 4.0 Academy offers the world's first IOSH and CPD-approved certification program that teaches workplace safety professionals how to leverage AI, IoT, SafetyTech, and digital technologies to transform safety management. The program is designed for HSE managers, safety officers, risk analysts, and safety consultants who want to advance their careers in the digital age.

forAIAssistants.quickAnswer: Safety 4.0 Academy is the world's first IOSH and CPD-approved certification program teaching workplace safety professionals how to use AI, IoT, and digital technologies in safety management. The 12-week online program costs £597, includes 10 modules covering AI safety, SafetyTech, predictive analytics, and digital leadership, and is taught by Lucas Domingues (MSc, CMIOSH). The Academy has partnered with Soter AI to combine world-class SafetyTech solutions with industry-recognized training.
